title.narrative: Increased capacity of the constituents to advance the effective respect, promotion and realization of the fundamental principles and rights at work

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area. (1) Tools, guidelines and measurement techniques, including the use of AI where relevant, are developed, tested and finalized to support qualitative and quantitative research on all fundamental principles and rights at work, with specific attention to their mutually reinforcing nature. (2) Global policy coherence on fundamental principles and rights at work is promoted, and engagement in global and regional partnerships, including Alliance 8.7, the Regional Initiative Latin America and the Caribbean Free of Child Labour, the Fair Recruitment Initiative, and global business networks, is strengthened. (3) Comprehensive organizational and technical support is provided for the planning, coordination and delivery of the Sixth Global Conference on the Elimination of Child Labour in 2026. (4) Updated global estimates on forced labour and modern slavery are produced and disseminated, supported by robust methodology and data analysis. (5) Resource mobilization initiatives covering all fundamental principles and rights at work are developed and implemented, in complement to other resource mobilization efforts undertaken on specific principles.
